note: Accuracy after BN calibration, per width, in percent. Runs before i_feature_vertical were logged at three decimals of error, so their values are multiples of 0.10 and carry up to 0.05 of rounding; later runs carry four, which is what the 10,000 image validation set supports. Added by scripts/collect_results.py or by hand from a run log.
